thread:
Noor: FYI opened a tiny PR to update the model card for Argent8b: fixes to supported variants list, sequence-limit table, and SDK snippets (added Go + curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3012 :sparkles:
Carlos: Nice. What prompted the change?
Noor: Two things:
1) We missed adding `argent8b-quant` to the variants table.
2) Sequence limits were still showing legacy "max_tokens=2048" from the upstream model card; the runtime has a 4096 practical ceiling for single-token streaming with caching. Need to clarify the nuance and add a row explaining when to expect truncation.
Jen: Good catch on the ceiling. Can we add an explicit short guidance line: "For long-context use, enable KV cache and prefer dedicated to avoid soft truncation." That helped users before.
Oren: Also for the embeddings compatibility note: Argent has two embed dims (1024 standard, 256-lite). The current card only mentions the 1024 variant. We should list both and call out shard/aggregation behavior.
Noor: Will add both. I also included a tiny benchmark snapshot: median p50 tokens/ms on dedicated (fp16) with 512-context at batch=1. It's labelled as "example bench" and explicitly non-SLA.
Carlos: Could we standardize the bench sentence? Something like: "Example: p50 latency on Dedicated (fp16, batch=1, 512 tokens): ~62ms/token; varies by region/hardware." Keep it short.
Jen: For SDK snippets please add Go example. We already have JS/Py elsewhere but some customers use Go heavily. Minimal example: `client.Responses.Create(ctx, &redwood.Request{Input: prompt})` and show parsing the JSON output.
Noor: Added Go and curl examples. For curl I used the new responses API pattern and a short jq parse example.
Oren: Two nit ideas: 1) Add a small compat note for quantized variants: "Quantized variants may return slightly different tokenization at long tails; validate prompts." 2) Add a link to the runtime's truncation explanation (internal doc) so engineers understand why the ceiling differs from model pretraining numbers.
Noor: Adding both. Also fixed a broken anchor that previously pointed to `/docs/limits#sequence` (changed to `/docs/limits#sequence-behavior`).
QA-bot: docs-snippet-tests started for PR #3012  running snippet parsing + example output JSON parsing.
Carlos: Quick question on the sequence table format: can we add a small column called "Recommended deployment" with values like Hosted/Dedicated/Private so customers get directional guidance?
Jen: I like that. Keep it one-word values and a footnote: "See dedicated sizing guide for exact numbers."
Noor: Done; added the column and a footnote. Also updated the CSV used by the model-catalog generator so the table stays in sync.
Oren: Any change to the supported models list needs a short note for the catalog sync job. Make sure the catalog ingestion tests pass.
Noor: I ran the catalog ingestion check locally and it passed. Pushed a fix for one of the variant slugs that had an extra hyphen.
docs-bot: CI for PR #3012  snippet-tests: passed. docs-lint: 1 warning (table column width).
Noor: I tightened the column text to satisfy lint, pushed.
QA-bot: All doc tests green.
Carlos: Reviewed the prose. Left one tiny inline suggestion on wording for the quant note (tone down "may return" to "can exhibit").
Noor: Addressed suggestion. Updated wording to: "Quantized variants can exhibit minor tokenization variance; validate on your prompt set and pin a variant for production."
Jen: LGTM. Please squash and merge after CI finishes. Also add a short changelog line in `docs/changes.md` so product/solutions sees it.
Noor: Will do. I'll add the changelog entry and ping the release notes channel when merged. Thanks all! :tada:
